Messages.Author: Jeff Kuta
Messages.Body:
Great deck!

Giotto's cycling ability is strong. Nice to see him featured so prominently. (only 2nd TWD with him in it)

Also way to crack open Kaymakli Fragment to show its power too. (first time it was featured with more than a single copy in a TWD)

And a great combination with Ashur Tablets to tune your hand and library to exactly what you need for the long game.

When you are anvil, be patient; when a hammer, strike.
